name: Fill a leaf with fishbone stitch
description: Cover a small leaf with diagonal stitches that overlap near the centre, working from the tip down.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fill a leaf with fishbone stitch.

levels.name: Lay the centre stitch
levels.completion_criterion: Bring the needle up at the tip and take it down to make one straight stitch along the middle.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Cross from both edges
levels.completion_criterion: Come up at one edge, cross the end of the centre stitch, then do the same from the other edge.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

levels.name: Continue to the base
levels.completion_criterion: Keep alternating edges until the leaf is covered, each stitch overlapping the end of the one before.
levels.safety_requirements: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

safety_notes: Sew on scrap. Stop if the needle points toward your hand.

name: Fold scrambled eggs off the heat
description: Beat eggs with cream or milk, fold them in a pan until they are softly set, and let the pan finish them off the heat.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fold scrambled eggs off the heat.

levels.name: Mix and melt
levels.completion_criterion: Beat the eggs with cream or milk and salt until the mix is even, and melt butter without letting it brown.
levels.safety_requirements: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the pan method from the opened guide, not a microwave method.

levels.name: Fold, then wait
levels.completion_criterion: Pour the eggs in, leave them briefly, then lift and fold from the edge toward the middle. Wait and fold again.
levels.safety_requirements: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the pan method from the opened guide, not a microwave method.

levels.name: Finish off the heat
levels.completion_criterion: Take the pan off while some egg is still soft, let the pan finish the cooking, and serve.
levels.safety_requirements: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the pan method from the opened guide, not a microwave method.

safety_notes: Stay with the hot pan. Use eggs you would eat. This is the pan method from the opened guide, not a microwave method.
